scripts.build: bun src/music/render-audio.ts && bun src/build.ts --out out/film-master.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/film-master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -tune animation -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart out/film.mp4
scripts.deploy: wolframscript -file data/deploy.wls && rm -rf out/hls && mkdir -p out/hls && ffmpeg -v error -i out/film.mp4 -c copy -hls_time 6 -hls_playlist_type vod -hls_segment_filename out/hls/seg%03d.ts out/hls/film.m3u8 && ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 81.2 -i out/film.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=1280:-1 -q:v 3 out/hls/poster.jpg && wolframscript -file data/deploy-player.wls
